# Feature: Wire world item-catalog into Character Inventory v2

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-06 — issue #143 -->

## Intent

Character Inventory v2 add-catalog uses Core + World `item-catalog` resolver + personal (per `allowPersonalItems`). Creating instances stays Inventory-v2; no schema/slot/stack changes. Library browse stays independent.

## Preconditions

- #142 `resolveWorldItemCatalog` + module defaults available.
- Inventory v2 already resolves `effectiveWorldProfileId`.
- Default empty module: packs/includes/excludes empty, `allowPersonalItems=true` → preserve prior Core+World+Personal semantics.

## Happy Path

- [ ] Add-catalog always includes 36 Core archetypes.
- [ ] With effective world: catalog = Core ∪ world-catalog resolver result (packs/includes/excludes/world defs/personal flag).
- [ ] Null world: Core + Personal only.
- [ ] Built-in standard items appear only via enabled pack/include of effective world (Library unchanged).
- [ ] Source labels: `Core`, `Standard`, `Welt`, `Eigen` (not color-only).
- [ ] New selection still creates normal ItemInstance with stable definitionId; slot/stack/equip/container rules unchanged.
- [ ] No 3D in inventory — thumbnail only.
- [ ] typed-strict on touched files.

## Edge Cases

- [ ] World without item-catalog module → defaults preserve prior semantics.
- [ ] Excluded pack item not offered for add; already-owned instance remains.
- [ ] Personal blocked when `allowPersonalItems=false`.

## Regression

- [ ] Inventory equipment/containers/mobile UX unchanged.
- [ ] Library Items browser still shows global authoring catalog.
- [ ] World editor item-catalog section unchanged.

## Assumptions

- Composition via public domain/infrastructure APIs; avoid duplicating resolver logic in UI.

## Implementation Notes

- Domain: `composeCharacterInventoryAddCatalog` in `src/domains/items/world-catalog.ts` (null world → Core+Personal; effective world → `resolveWorldItemCatalog`).
- Infrastructure: `loadCharacterItemCatalog` loads world `modules` via `loadWorldProfileModules`, applies `getItemCatalogModuleConfig`, composes addable; lookup + `assertWritableInventoryV2` accept builtin-standard for owned instances.
- RLS: migration `019_world_profiles_read_for_adventure.sql` — adventure members can SELECT world_profiles (modules) via `current_user_can_read_world_profile`.
- UI: `InventoryCatalogDialog` source badges Core/Standard/Welt/Eigen (text), optional Quelle/Setting/Kontext filters, `InventoryItemThumb` only (no 3D).
- Contract: `scripts/item-inventory-world-catalog-wire-check.mjs` wired in `test-gate.mjs`. Library `loadLibraryItemCatalog` unchanged.
